articles.summary: Effortlessly keep your contract library organized and actionable with our latest updates. Instantly upload documents by email, track every extracted value back to its original clause with clickable source citations, and receive redline analysis reports right in your inbox. Power users can now archive or reprocess documents in bulk, while smarter search makes finding the right agreement even faster. All wrapped in a refreshed, streamlined login experience—making Docsum smoother and more intuitive than ever.
articles.title: 🚀 Product Update: Email Uploads, Smarter Extraction, and Workflow Superpowers
